name: Consent Manager
summary: Controlled consent-decision composition with an in-flow first layer, explicit accept/reject/customize requests, canonical Modal preferences, and target-owned policy, state, persistence, processing, provider, and audit behavior.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Controlled, named, non-modal first-layer section rendered in normal document flow.

anatomy.name: content
anatomy.description: Localized title, explanation, and real policy Link region.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Visible localized heading that names the first layer.

anatomy.name: description
anatomy.description: Target-approved explanation of the requested decision.

anatomy.name: policyLink
anatomy.description: Canonical Link with a real target-owned policy destination.

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: Equal-access canonical Button group for accept, reject, and customize requests.

anatomy.name: acceptAction
anatomy.description: Explicit accept request; the target decides and persists the result.

anatomy.name: rejectAction
anatomy.description: Explicit reject request with the same interaction access as accept.

anatomy.name: customizeAction
anatomy.description: Canonical Modal trigger for target-supplied detailed preferences.

anatomy.name: feedback
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned pending, result, error, or retry composition with context-appropriate semantics.

anatomy.name: preferencesModal
anatomy.description: Canonical Modal composition for detailed preferences; G9 adds no overlay or focus system.

anatomy.name: preferencesList
anatomy.description: Target-supplied category/value slot composed from canonical choice controls.

anatomy.name: saveAction
anatomy.description: Explicit target-handled save request inside the canonical Modal footer.

variants.name: default
variants.description: One in-flow consent-decision surface; viewport placement is target-owned and is not a variant.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Intrinsic container-responsive presentation with no viewport-width API.

states.name: closed
states.description: Authoritative target state omits or natively hides both the first layer and preferences from interaction.

states.name: open
states.description: Valid named first layer is present in normal document flow.

states.name: busy
states.description: Target mutation is pending; request actions are unavailable and target feedback may explain progress.

states.name: preferencesOpen
states.description: Canonical Modal is open with target-owned current category values.

behavior.name: controlledVisibility
behavior.description: Open, preferences-open, and busy state are controlled target projections. Closed content is omitted or natively hidden, never translated offscreen.

behavior.name: explicitDecisionRequests
behavior.description: Three explicit native Button activations request target action. No dismissal, inactivity, scrolling, or page continuation is interpreted as consent.

behavior.name: preferenceComposition
behavior.description: Detailed preferences consume canonical Modal and canonical choice controls. Modal owns its complete focus/dismissal lifecycle; the target owns supplied categories, values, validation, save, and results.

behavior.name: providerBoundary
behavior.description: The neutral component performs no jurisdiction lookup, cookie/storage access, resource blocking, provider call, persistence, analytics, or compliance claim.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Visible localized first-layer title and accessible name.

properties.name: policyLabel
properties.description: Localized visible label for the canonical policy Link.

properties.name: policyHref
properties.description: Real target-owned policy destination; placeholder-only links are invalid.

properties.name: acceptLabel
properties.description: Localized label for the explicit accept request.

properties.name: rejectLabel
properties.description: Localized label for the explicit reject request.

properties.name: customizeLabel
properties.description: Localized label for the preferences Modal trigger.

properties.name: preferencesTitle
properties.description: Visible localized title and accessible name for the canonical preferences Modal.

properties.name: preferencesDescription
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the introductory paragraph; category labels and descriptions remain target-owned.
properties.description: Optional localized introduction above the target category controls.

properties.name: preferences
properties.description: Target-supplied current categories and values composed from canonical choice controls.

properties.name: closePreferencesLabel
properties.description: Contextual accessible label for the canonical Close Button.

properties.name: saveLabel
properties.description: Localized label for the explicit save-preferences request.

properties.name: feedback
properties.description: Optional target-owned pending, result, error, or retry composition; its semantics and copy depend on the actual result.

properties.name: open
properties.description: Controls whether the valid first layer and any preferences surface are present; the target derives this from authoritative policy/provider state.

properties.name: preferencesOpen
properties.description: Controls the canonical preferences Modal; customize and close actions emit requests for the target to reconcile.

properties.name: busy
properties.description: Projects a target-owned pending mutation and disables further decision/save requests without inventing a result model.

accessibility: Render a visible localized heading and a real policy Link before requesting a decision.
Keep Accept, Reject, and Customize as explicit keyboard-reachable canonical Buttons with equal interaction access.
Never infer consent from closing, inactivity, scrolling, or continued use.
Omit or natively hide the entire controlled composition when closed; do not leave an offscreen focusable copy.
Compose canonical Modal for preferences, including naming, initial focus, Tab containment, Escape, visible close, and logical focus restoration.
Compose target categories from labeled canonical choice controls and preserve authoritative current values.
Give target feedback the semantics appropriate to the real pending, success, or error result; do not announce a result before provider reconciliation.
Keep the first layer in normal flow unless a target separately owns and tests fixed/sticky obstruction, safe-area, and stacking policy.

web.notes: In-flow controlled first layer composes canonical Button, Link, Modal, and Checkbox surfaces; provider, persistence, and policy behavior remain target-owned.

shopify.notes: A future target adapter must project Shopify Customer Privacy state and mutations into this contract; copied CSS is not provider readiness.
